strategy.offer: Integrated third-party ship management and complementary maritime services, including technical, crew, commercial, training, procurement, maintenance, travel, lay-up, recycling, and project support.
strategy.customers: Ship owners, operators and other maritime businesses seeking tailored support across vessel operations, lifecycle projects, crewing, compliance, and performance improvement.
strategy.why_we_win: Long-term relationships, experienced retained people, transparent tailored service, strong safety and compliance, and digital tools drive vessel availability, lower operating costs, and protect clients’ reputations.
strategy.resources: International network of management, crewing and training centres; large seafarer and shore workforce; software, procurement systems, supplier links, project managers, and maritime know-how.
strategy.direction: Expanding from core ship management into integrated maritime solutions, with more digitalisation and greater support for efficiency, transparency, and environmental performance.
